name: dev.brandpilot/brandpilot-mcp
description: MCP server for BrandPilot (DesignFlow): browse public design systems, pull a design's continuation bundle and prompt pack, and hand finished external work back - natively from Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor or any MCP client.

environmentVariables.name: DESIGNFLOW_HANDOFF_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Design handoff key from a BrandPilot design page (Continue this design, Copy API key). Optional: only the design-scoped tools need it, and each of them also accepts an explicit handoffKey argument.

environmentVariables.name: BRANDPILOT_ORIGIN
environmentVariables.description: BrandPilot origin the server talks to. Defaults to https://brandpilot.dev.
